list.name: day
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT day::text FROM traffic_by_hour ORDER BY day

panels.title: Luu luong truy cap theo gio

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", SUM(hits) AS "requests" FROM traffic_timeseries WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND day::text IN (${day:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 20 IP truy cap nhieu nhat

targets.rawSql: SELECT ip, SUM(hits) AS hits FROM top_ips WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND day::text IN (${day:sqlstring}) GROUP BY ip ORDER BY hits DESC, ip LIMIT 20

panels.title: Phan bo ma HTTP theo ngay

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::text AS day, status::text AS status, hits FROM status_by_day WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND day::text IN (${day:sqlstring}) ORDER BY day, status
SELECT day, url, hits FROM top_urls_by_day WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND day::text IN (${day:sqlstring}) ORDER BY day, hits DESC, url
